units.source_text: 不过，我佯装出一副少年的模样（惟有这种时候，

en.t: However, I put on the appearance of a boy; only at such times,

units.source_text: 谁有故意演戏的时候，我才像个少年），兴高采烈，几乎跑在前头。

en.t: when someone was deliberately acting a part, did I seem like a boy. In high spirits, I almost ran on ahead.

units.source_text: 于是，我梦幻多年的金阁，

en.t: And then the Golden Pavilion, which I had dreamed of for so many years,

units.source_text: 就这样轻易地以其全貌展现在我的眼前。

en.t: so easily revealed its entire form before my eyes.
